liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack-A-Roe** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Jack-A-Roe in the acoustic set; Reviewer calls this Jack-A-Roe particularly excellent [15][16]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Peggy-O and enjoys the acoustic sets [9]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer finds Bird Song captivating [10]
- **Rosalie McFall** (1 review): Reviewer finds Rosalie McFall invigorating [10]
- **Beat It On Down The Line** (1 review): Reviewer notes this oldie from the first Dead album was rarely played in the 1970s [14]
- **China Doll** (1 review): Reviewer singles out China Doll in the acoustic set [15]
- **Dark Hollow** (1 review): Reviewer especially loved the Dark Hollow [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd80-09-30 s1t01 On The Road Again**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-09-30 s1t02 Jack-A-Roe**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-09-30 s1t03 Monkey & The Engineer**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-09-30 s1t04 Bird Song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-09-30 s1t05 Dark Hollow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-09-30 s1t06 Rosalie McFall**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-09-30 s1t07 Heaven Help The Fool**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-09-30 s1t08 China Doll**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-09-30.144728.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 34 songs; 219 min [1]
- **gd1980-09-30.fob-nak700.ellner-marino.gmb.89554.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 31 songs; 213 min [4]. Said about its sound: Discs are seamless, with occasional static pops [4]
- **gd80-09-30.menke.vernon.12882.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 28 songs; 202 min; rated 3.44/5 by 9 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the audience recording's sound quality is excellent, and the setlist material is strong; Crowd is somewhat louder in this recording; vocals sound really good for 1980; Reviewer says the crowd overpowers the band, making the audience recording unlistenable; wishes a board existed [8][10][11][12][13][17]
- **gd1980-09-30.set1.sbd.miller.96066.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 10 songs; 47 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [7]. Said about its sound: Soundboard of the acoustic first set runs about 47 minutes and is beautifully recorded [15]

## Around the show

- Acoustic sets revived old songs the band hadn't played in ten years [14]
- Audience tapers in this run had to conceal their gear because the band was recording for Reckoning and Dead Set [17]
- Reviewer likes the September and October acoustic sets that formed Reckoning; this one is good, but better ones exist [14]
- Reviewer finds the acoustic sets from this run nearly indistinguishable in consistency and setlists [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-09-30.144728.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; (3) x Nakamichi 700 mics (left/right cardioids, omni center - handheld shoulder high)> Custom mixer by Jamie Poris >… [1]. Also: Master cassettes came from Mark Severson; Charlie Miller transferred them and coordinated the effort, with pitch correction; A first-generation Nakamichi 700 source supplies four songs in full, plus a ten-second patch in Drums [1]
- **gd1980-09-30.fob-nak700.ellner-marino.gmb.89554.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ron Ellner; transferred by Mike Marino and Bill Koucky; source: Master Cassette > Nakamichi 700s > Sony TC D-5 > Teac Reel to Reel [4]. Also: Source CD was retracked so the encore sits at the end of disc 3; crossfades added before Samson & Delilah and Brokedown Palace [4]
- **gd80-09-30.menke.vernon.12882.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Bob Menke; source: Audience Recording: Nak CM700's [6]
- **gd1980-09-30.set1.sbd.miller.96066.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> 24 Track Master Reel -> Cassette -> Cassette [7]
